items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: No, I never know Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: broke up? Oh, well, Solistan made up his own band. I mean, on the trumpet, when Ridgely. Shatz. Shatz. And was he playing with you at the Pete Hermans? Who, Shatz? Yeah, I forget who you said was there. Yeah, Shatz was on trumpet at Pete Hermans. Uh-huh. Mm-hmm. Okay, he was playing trumpet. What else? I was wondering about, uh, did you ever meet Charlie Parker around Kansas City or St. Louis or any of those places?
Charlie Parker? Mm-hmm. No, I don't think. Uh-uh. Yeah, I just, I just wondered if he was
coming up then in those years. No. Did you ever know him? No, I never know Charlie Parker. Somebody had just mentioned, you know, that he used to listen to you. Somebody told me that, you know.
